description.value: Scotia Barn (formerly Burnaby 8 Rinks) is one of Canada's largest multi-rink indoor ice facilities, operated by Canlan Sports and featuring six NHL-sized ice rinks, a dedicated figure skating rink, and an indoor soccer field. It hosts competitive leagues, drop-in programs, camps, and tournaments year-round for youth and adults across Metro Vancouver. As a large commercial sports complex, it caters primarily to ice hockey and skating participants rather than touring cyclists.
